When the equipper launches and hits an enemy with a Basic Attack, apply Wilt to the target for 30s, stacking up to 20 times, repeated triggers reset the duration. When any squad member hits an enemy, for every stack of Wilt applied to the target, the CRIT DMG of the Ice DMG and Fire DMG dealt by that attack increases by 1.5%. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.

basic.name: 普通攻击：L式轰鸣拳
basic.trigger: 点按或长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.triggerEn: Press or hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
basic.description:
点按或长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的打击，造成物理伤害和火属性伤害；
在[普通攻击]第三段发动期间，拖曳摇杆，同时连点或长按 【普通攻击键】 ，可以持续发动连续体术追击，松开摇杆，则衔接后继第四段[普通攻击]；
在[普通攻击]第五段轻拳起攻期间，拖曳摇杆，同时连点或长按 【普通攻击键】 ，可以循环发动轻拳起攻和第四段[普通攻击]，松开摇杆，则衔接后继刺拳连击；
保持连点或长按 【普通攻击键】 时，可以延长刺拳连击的持续时间；
停止连点或长按 【普通攻击键】 后，或刺拳连击至持续时间上限后，将向前方发动终结一击，终结一击期间拥有无敌效果；
[普通攻击]第五段发动期间，莱特受到的伤害降低40%；
[士气喷发]状态下，[普通攻击]第五段发动期间抗打断等级提升，伤害降低效果提升至80%。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press or hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Perform up to five forward strikes, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
During the 3rd hit of the Basic Attack, drag the joystick, and repeatedly press or hold [Basic Attack] to unleash a series of melee follow-up attacks. Release the joystick to follow up with the 4th hit of the Basic Attack.
While performing the startup light punch in the 5th hit of the Basic Attack, drag the joystick and repeatedly press or hold [Basic Attack] to keep alternating between the light punch and 4th hit of the Basic Attack. Release the joystick to follow up with the subsequent jab combo.
Continue repeatedly pressing or holding [Basic Attack] to extend the duration of the jab combo.
When you stop pressing or holding [Basic Attack], or when the combo reaches its maximum duration, launches a Finishing Move forward. Lighter is invulnerable during the Finishing Move.
During the 5th hit of the Basic Attack, Lighter takes 40% less DMG.
While in the Morale Burst state, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased during the 5th hit of his Basic Attack, and the DMG reduction effect is increased to 80%.

special.name: 特殊技：V式日轮升拳
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：

招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
垫步闪避期间，点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
使用组合拳向前方进行打击，造成火属性伤害；
发动该招式不会打断[普通攻击]的连击段数；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Strikes enemies in front with an uppercut, dealing Fire DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
Press [Special Attack] during a shuffle dodge to activate:
Strike forward with a series of punches, dealing Fire DMG.
This skill will not interrupt the combo count for Basic Attacks.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：V式日轮升拳-全冲程
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: V-Form Sunrise Uppercut - Full Distance
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
使用上勾拳离地跃起并向前方进行强力打击，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动期间，再次点按 【强化特殊技键】 可以额外消耗能量，发动强力追击，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果，
招式发动后，点按或长按 【普通攻击键】 可以直接衔接发动第四段[普通攻击]。
垫步闪避期间，能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
使用组合拳向前方进行强力打击，造成大量火属性伤害；
发动该招式不会打断[普通攻击]的连击段数；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，点按或长按 【普通攻击键】 可以直接衔接发动第五段[普通攻击]。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Strikes enemies in front with a powerful uppercut, leaping into the air and dealing massive Fire DMG.
During the move, press [EX Special Attack] again to spend additional Energy to perform a powerful follow-up attack, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill
After using the move, press or hold [Basic Attack] to transition to the 4th hit of the Basic Attack.
During the shuffle dodge, with enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Perform a powerful combo punch forward, dealing massive Fire DMG. Using this skill will not break the combo count for Basic Attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After the attack, press or hold [Basic Attack] to immediately transition into the 5th hit of the Basic Attack.

facts.text:
莱特会随时间自动获得[士气]，每秒回复2.9点，队伍中任意角色每消耗1点能量值，额外为莱特回复0.26点[士气]，莱特最多拥有100点[士气]；[士气]回复至80点时，下一次换入前场将直接发动[快速支援]；[士气]大于等于80点后，莱特发动第五段[普通攻击]时，将进入[士气喷发]状态，提升[普通攻击]第五段中轻拳起攻、刺拳连击和终结一击的威力；威力提升后，招式命中敌人时，会持续消耗[士气]，每消耗10点[士气]，莱特的冲击力提升2%，最多提升20%，持续6秒；
[士气喷发]状态下，莱特不再随时间自动获得[士气]，轻拳起攻或刺拳连击期间耗尽[士气]时，会自动衔接发动更加强力的终结一击；
[士气喷发]状态下，轻拳起攻或刺拳连击命中敌人时，目标的冰属性伤害抗性和火属性伤害抗性降低15%，持续30秒；
[士气喷发]状态下，终结一击命中敌人时，会对目标施加[溃败]效果，使其进入失衡状态后的失衡持续时间提升3秒，从失衡状态恢复前[溃败]效果对同一目标最多触发一次；
[普通攻击]第五段终结一击命中敌人、换回后场或[士气]耗尽时，莱特将退出[士气喷发]状态，尚未消耗的[士气]会被保留。
facts.textEn:
Lighter automatically gains Morale over time, at a rate of 2.9 points per second. For each point of Energy consumed by any squad member, Lighter recovers an additional 0.26 Morale, up to a maximum of 100. When Morale reaches 80, the next time Lighter switches into battle he immediately launches a Quick Assist. Once Morale is 80 or higher, executing the 5th hit of his Basic Attack puts Lighter in the Morale Burst state, enhancing the power of the startup light punch, jab combo, and the Finishing Move of the 5th hit of his Basic Attack. When a skill hits an enemy with its power increased, it will continuously consume Morale. With every 10 points of Morale consumed, Lighter's Impact increases by 2%, up to a maximum increase of 20%, and lasting 6s.
In the Morale Burst state, Lighter will no longer automatically gain Morale over time. If his Morale is exhausted during a startup light punch or jab combo, he will automatically follow up with a more powerful Finishing Move.
In the Morale Burst state, when startup light punches or jab combos hit enemies, the target's Ice RES and Fire RES are reduced by 15%, lasting 30s.
In the Morale Burst state, when the Finishing Move hits an enemy, it applies the Collapse effect on the target, extending its Stunned duration by 3s. The Collapse effect can trigger only once on the same target before they recover from Stun.
When the Finishing Move of the 5th hit of his Basic Attack hits an enemy, when he switches off field, or when his Morale runs out, Lighter will leave the Morale Burst state, keeping any unspent Morale.

cinema.name: 常胜冠军
cinema.description: 在[核心被动：助燃剂]所施加的减益效果中，[溃败]效果将使失衡持续时间提升5秒，冰属性伤害抗性和火属性伤害抗性将额外降低10%；在轻拳起攻或刺拳连击期间耗尽[士气]，自动衔接发动强力终结一击时，强力终结一击造成的伤害提升30%。
cinema.descriptionEn: Among the debuffs imposed by Core Passive: Accelerant, the Collapse effect increases Stun duration by 5s, while further reducing Ice RES and Fire RES by 10%. The more powerful Finishing Move that follows when Lighter's Morale is completely exhausted during a startup light punch or jab combo deals 30% increased DMG.

cinema.name: 红围巾
cinema.description: 通过[核心被动：助燃剂]对敌人施加[溃败]效果时，目标的失衡易伤倍率提升25%；[额外能力：斗志昂扬]中由[昂扬]提供的冰属性伤害和火属性伤害增益效果提升至原本的120%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When applying Collapse via Core Passive: Accelerant to enemies, the target's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 25%. The increase to Ice DMG and Fire DMG provided by Elation from Additional Ability: Fighting Spirit increases to 120% of the original.

cinema.name: 佣兵团长
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 墨镜
cinema.description: 莱特位于后场时，前场角色的能量自动回复效率提升10%；莱特进入[士气喷发]状态时，为后场角色回复4点能量，18秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Lighter is off-field, the Energy Regen for the on-field character is increased by 10%. Upon entering the Morale Burst state, Lighter restores 4 Energy for off-field characters. This effect can trigger once every 18s.

cinema.name: 决策者
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 幸存者
cinema.description: 莱特的[士气]回复效率提升至原本的200%；莱特在[普通攻击]、[闪避反击]、[特殊技]、[强化特殊技]、[快速支援]、[支援突击]、[连携技]、[终结技]中发动重击命中敌人时，将会触发[火焰冲击]效果，造成250%攻击力的火属性伤害，每个敌人8秒内最多触发一次；若莱特的冲击力高于170点，每超过1点冲击力会使[火焰冲击]的倍率额外提升5%，最多提升500%；在轻拳起攻或刺拳连击期间耗尽[士气]，自动衔接发动强力终结一击命中敌人时，可以忽略冷却时间，额外触发一次[火焰冲击]效果。
cinema.descriptionEn: Lighter's Morale recovery efficiency is increased to 200% of its original value. When Lighter lands a heavy strike on enemies during a Basic Attack, Dodge Counter, Special Attack, EX Special Attack, Quick Assist, Assist Follow-Up, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, it will trigger the Blazing Impact effect, dealing 250% of ATK as Fire DMG. This effect can trigger once every 8s on each enemy. If Lighter's Impact exceeds 170 points, each additional point will further increase the multiplier of Blazing Impact by 5%, up to a maximum increase of 500%. The more powerful Finishing Move that follows when Lighter's Morale is completely exhausted during a light punch or jab combo will trigger an additional activation of Blazing Impact when hitting an enemy, ignoring the effect's cooldown.

basic.name: 普通攻击：L式轰鸣拳
basic.description:
点按或长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的打击，造成物理伤害和火属性伤害；
在[普通攻击]第三段发动期间，拖曳摇杆，同时连点或长按 【普通攻击键】 ，可以持续发动连续体术追击，松开摇杆，则衔接后继第四段[普通攻击]；
在[普通攻击]第五段轻拳起攻期间，拖曳摇杆，同时连点或长按 【普通攻击键】 ，可以循环发动轻拳起攻和第四段[普通攻击]，松开摇杆，则衔接后继刺拳连击；
保持连点或长按 【普通攻击键】 时，可以延长刺拳连击的持续时间；
停止连点或长按 【普通攻击键】 后，或刺拳连击至持续时间上限后，将向前方发动终结一击，终结一击期间拥有无敌效果；
[普通攻击]第五段发动期间，莱特受到的伤害降低40%；
[士气喷发]状态下，[普通攻击]第五段发动期间抗打断等级提升，伤害降低效果提升至80%。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press or hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Perform up to five forward strikes, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
During the 3rd hit of the Basic Attack, drag the joystick, and repeatedly press or hold [Basic Attack] to unleash a series of melee follow-up attacks. Release the joystick to follow up with the 4th hit of the Basic Attack.
While performing the startup light punch in the 5th hit of the Basic Attack, drag the joystick and repeatedly press or hold [Basic Attack] to keep alternating between the light punch and 4th hit of the Basic Attack. Release the joystick to follow up with the subsequent jab combo.
Continue repeatedly pressing or holding [Basic Attack] to extend the duration of the jab combo.
When you stop pressing or holding [Basic Attack], or when the combo reaches its maximum duration, launches a Finishing Move forward. Lighter is invulnerable during the Finishing Move.
During the 5th hit of the Basic Attack, Lighter takes 40% less DMG.
While in the Morale Burst state, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased during the 5th hit of his Basic Attack, and the DMG reduction effect is increased to 80%.

basic.name: 冲刺攻击：骸突
basic.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行快速打击，造成物理伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Rapidly strikes enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

ex.name: 特殊技：V式日轮升拳
ex.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
使用上勾拳向前方进行打击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
垫步闪避期间，点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
使用组合拳向前方进行打击，造成火属性伤害；
发动该招式不会打断[普通攻击]的连击段数；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
ex.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Strikes enemies in front with an uppercut, dealing Fire DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
Press [Special Attack] during a shuffle dodge to activate:
Strike forward with a series of punches, dealing Fire DMG.
This skill will not interrupt the combo count for Basic Attacks.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：V式日轮升拳-全冲程
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: V-Form Sunrise Uppercut - Full Distance
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
使用上勾拳离地跃起并向前方进行强力打击，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动期间，再次点按 【强化特殊技键】 可以额外消耗能量，发动强力追击，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果，
招式发动后，点按或长按 【普通攻击键】 可以直接衔接发动第四段[普通攻击]。
垫步闪避期间，能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
使用组合拳向前方进行强力打击，造成大量火属性伤害；
发动该招式不会打断[普通攻击]的连击段数；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，点按或长按 【普通攻击键】 可以直接衔接发动第五段[普通攻击]。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Strikes enemies in front with a powerful uppercut, leaping into the air and dealing massive Fire DMG.
During the move, press [EX Special Attack] again to spend additional Energy to perform a powerful follow-up attack, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill
After using the move, press or hold [Basic Attack] to transition to the 4th hit of the Basic Attack.
During the shuffle dodge, with enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Perform a powerful combo punch forward, dealing massive Fire DMG. Using this skill will not break the combo count for Basic Attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After the attack, press or hold [Basic Attack] to immediately transition into the 5th hit of the Basic Attack.

ultimate.name: 终结技：W式桂冠终火
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对身周大范围敌人发动强力打击，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleashes a powerful strike in a large area around, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：烈闪-守
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动打击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，点按或长按 【普通攻击键】 可以直接衔接发动第五段[普通攻击]。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Strike enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using the skill, press or hold [Basic Attack] to immediately follow up with the 5th hit of the Basic Attack.
